newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsubishi Galant orders exceed target.
newsitem.headline: Mitsubishi Galant orders exceed target.

text.p: Mitsubishi Motors Corp said on Friday it received 8,300 domestic orders for its Galant sedan and Legnum station wagon in the first 10 days after its launch.
Mitsubishi launched the remodelled Galant and a completely new Galant Legnum on August 29 with a monthly target of a total 7,000 units.

Of the total, orders for Galant powered by 1.8-litre Gasoline Direct Injection (GDI) fuel-economy engine accounted for 91 percent, up from 85 percent Mitsubishi earlier projected. Mitsubishi may boost output of the GDI engine, a Mitsubishi spokeswoman said.
